opening.argument: The presentation actively promotes OneCoin as a business and income opportunity through paid entry, recruitment, and tiered rewards. It instructs viewers to register through a sponsor and “buy an activation kit,” then promises that they can invite unlimited partners and receive a 10% bonus. It further links purchasing a TYKUN package twice with accumulating, selling, and earning from tokens, while presenting user mining and token trading as participation benefits. Early partners are described as especially generously rewarded, reinforcing the incentive to join and build the network. The closing direction to “reserve in Binari or make payments” and visit the team site confirms an active solicitation, rather than neutral cryptocurrency education.

citations.quote: You go to Business, you have a referral link from your sponsor, you register and buy an activation kit.
So you can invite partners in unlimited amount and will get bonus of 10% from BV.
If you buy a TYKUN package twice, you can accumulate and sell tokens and earn with it
My first partners will be especially generously rewarded.
Now reserve in Binari or make payments. Go to the team site.
